_comment: Manual knowledge-discount layer applied on top of xG-based team ratings. attack > 1.0 = stronger attack vs baseline; defense > 1.0 = concedes more (weaker), < 1.0 = tighter (stronger). Keep multipliers in [0.85, 1.15]. Remove entries once ~6 GWs of real-season xG exist. Do not stack multipliers across weeks — always write the combined current value.
_workflow: Maintained weekly by the transfer-watch agent. Only confirmed, material events trigger updates: confirmed transfers of key players (starters, elite creators, first-choice GK/CB), permanent manager appointments with distinct tactical identity, long-term injuries (8+ weeks) to clearly key players. Backup signings are not material.
